first.rationale: I intend to test onboarding simplification because completion and activation are both declining, and the archived evidence indicates shortening onboarding improved time-to-value and early adoption. I would verify the pricing record as a competing response to the competitor, while preserving uncertainty because its readout pooled cohorts after a mid-test redefinition. A small guarded test can assess activation and qualified-revenue effects without broadly trading away monetization.
